rationale: Reviewed Copilot-only manifest, ten compact dispatcher-first skills, required contracts, exact-version runtime, Delivery Path Search input-integrity provenance, evidence-plane separation, shared run-identity validation, fail-closed localized QA, UAT and task-target values, terminal unresolved-target behavior, complete user-facing locale binding, localized CD+Tests actions and repository-aware SessionStart classification. The executable skill dispatcher adds exactly two bounded runtime files, strict registry validation, fail-closed deterministic presentation, one always-available non-authorizing binding, a machine-readable host_action carrying the exact terminal text, machine-readable ordinary-conversation, runtime-mention, activation, pre-dispatch and terminal-output constraints, silent SessionStart context, and delayed loading of shared target and interaction contracts while retaining consent-gated repository checks. Request Activation adds one canonical runtime-contract file, a fingerprint-bound passive guard projected into the router and all ten skills, definition-owned module inventory, silent ordinary-request abstention, and passive binding identity without another hook, classifier, prompt transport, or dispatcher field. The reviewed atomic canonical-init, strict lifecycle-envelope, stale-package cleanup, host-evidence schema, and control-setup continuation changes raise the measured payload to 85 files/696486 bytes. Any further increase requires review. SD2 transport correction adds exactly one shared runtime binding module, changing the file ceiling from 85 to 86. The byte ceiling remains 696486; the regenerated candidate measures 679898 bytes. Instruction budgets, activation kernel and hook inventory are unchanged. Approved host-adapter compatibility extraction adds exactly five pure runtime command modules (four host leaves and one shared formatter), raising the reviewed file ceiling from 86 to 91. The regenerated candidate measures 682058 bytes, below the unchanged 696486-byte ceiling. The MCP dispatch contract reuses the same generated dispatcher, and its read-only import closure adds exactly four shared reader or observation modules plus the reviewed semantic and locale changes. The initial measured Copilot payload was 95 files and 707710 bytes. Exact MCP SDK runtime provenance adds no file and 587 reviewed bytes to the already shared provenance owner, producing 95 files and 708297 bytes. Structural read-only Git worktree validation adds 784 reviewed bytes without another file, producing 95 files and 709081 bytes. The bounded runtime probe timeout increase adds 60 reviewed bytes and prevents SessionStart binding loss during transient process-start delay, producing 95 files and 709141 bytes. Canonical worker wire parsing now leaves semantic value validation to the existing dispatcher service; the reviewed regression adds 119 bytes without another file, producing 95 files and 709260 bytes. Canonical PRD-gate action and transition translations add 2554 reviewed bytes without another file, producing 95 files and 711814 bytes and preventing fail-closed German status-card loss after an evidence-contract revision. Canonical serialization of the existing ordered approval-presentation blocks adds 692 reviewed bytes without another file, producing 95 files and 712506 bytes and preventing an empty terminal host action at an approval gate. Canonical SD-gate action and transition translations add 1368 reviewed bytes without another file, producing 95 files and 713874 bytes and preventing fail-closed German status-card loss after PRD approval. Canonical TP-gate action and transition translations add 1652 reviewed bytes without another file, producing 95 files and 715526 bytes and preventing fail-closed German status-card loss after SD approval. MCP lifecycle, server, SDK packages, package acquisition and capability metadata remain excluded from the Copilot profile. Canonical Brownfield, CD+Tests, Code Review and QA transition translations add 4430 reviewed bytes without another file, producing 95 files and 719956 bytes and preventing fail-closed German status-card loss throughout the internal post-TP path. Canonical OR delivery-closeout translations add 1784 reviewed bytes without another file, producing 95 files and 721740 bytes and preventing fail-closed German status-card loss after UAT approval.
